methodology: Empirical fraction of NFL regular-season games with recorded event; not a prediction for any particular matchup. Wilson 95% interval. Source: nflverse play-by-play CC BY 4.0.

Will a game have a safety?.definition: A game contains at least one play flagged as a safety.

Will a punt be blocked and returned for.definition: A play is marked as a blocked punt and a return touchdown.

Will there be 15+ accepted penalties in.definition: At least 15 play-by-play rows have an accepted penalty flag; multiple penalties on a single play may be undercounted.

Will there be 125+ total penalty yards i.definition: Sum of absolute penalty_yards across recorded plays reaches 125; play-by-play may omit offsetting or declined penalties.

Will a player be flagged for taunting af.definition: A taunting penalty appears on a play marked first down; sequence after the first down cannot be confirmed.
